title: Risk-Controlled Complaint Routing Across Real Taxonomy Breaks: benchmark code and data
description: Benchmark for risk-controlled complaint routing across two dated taxonomy breaks in the public CFPB consumer complaint narratives (2015-2025): dated label regimes, a typed crosswalk, seeded sample IDs (no narrative text), cached per-item outputs of three cascade tiers and a frozen-embedding tier, all monthly results, the replay harness, a 300-item label-noise audit, the dated protocol and a datasheet. Code is MIT; derived files are CC BY 4.0; the source records are CC0 (CFPB).
